meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: local worker plus CMEM Pro observer (default), optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. No Cursor required.

copy.tagline: 为聊天助手装上跨会话记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给 Grok 机器人增加持久记忆能力。
copy.tagline_en: Give your chat assistant persistent memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add lasting memory to your Grok bot.

howto.what: 装好后本机 127.0.0.1（默认 37700+uid%100）运行 worker，为每个 Grok Bot agent 监视对话记录，默认用 CMEM Pro 观察器，任务开始时经 MCP 给出 session_start_context。
howto.when: 当你要在 Grok Bot 上安装 claude-mem 时触发：默认是本地 worker + CMEM Pro 观察器，也可选 host 登录观察器或远程 cmem.ai。不需要 Cursor。

say.text: 帮我装远程版：server 运行模式，地址 https://cmem.ai。

howto.what_en: After install, a local worker runs on 127.0.0.1 (default 37700+uid%100), watches transcripts per Grok Bot agent, uses the CMEM Pro observer by default, and supplies session_start_context via MCP when a real task starts.
howto.when_en: Use it when installing claude-mem on Grok Bot: default local worker plus CMEM Pro observer, optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. No Cursor required.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Grok Bot with the default CMEM Pro observer.
Install with --provider host for the host-login observer.
say_en.note: Adds the loopback shim; explicit opt-in

say_en.text: Install the remote version with --runtime server --server-url https://cmem.ai.
